original_value: In the age of the Internet, basic education faces several new challenges: the lack of deep integration of artificial intelligence (AI), and the relatively poor quality of online teaching. To cope with these challenges, this paper designs an evaluation method for online teaching quality of basic education in the context of the AI. Firstly, the application of the AI in basic education was analyzed, and the promoting effect of online teaching on basic education was confirmed. On this basis, the entropy weight method and grey clustering analysis were introduced to evaluate the online teaching quality of basic ed-ucation. Based on the proposed model, several strategies were proposed to improve the quality of online teaching in basic education. The research re-sults provide a good reference for the application of online teaching and AI in basic education.

result.paraphrase: In the Internet era, basic education is confronted with new challenges, including the insufficient integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and the comparatively low quality of online instruction. To address these issues, this paper proposes an evaluation approach for the quality of online teaching in basic education under the AI context. It first examines how AI is applied in basic education and verifies the positive role of online teaching in supporting basic education. On this basis, the entropy weight method and grey clustering analysis are adopted to assess the quality of online teaching in basic education. Using the proposed model, several measures are then suggested to improve the quality of online teaching in basic education. The findings offer a useful reference for applying online teaching and AI in basic education.
